description: Approved Relationship labels for Effect Summary rows in the SB-CPD research area. Evidence Mapping uses the seven core pathways; Effect Summary may additionally use cross-program design associations.

relationships.label: PD → Teacher Knowledge
relationships.summary: Effect of PD/intervention on teacher knowledge measures.

relationships.label: PD → Teaching Practice
relationships.summary: Effect of PD/intervention on teaching practice measures.

relationships.label: PD → Student Achievement
relationships.summary: Effect of PD/intervention on student achievement or learning outcomes.

relationships.label: Teacher Knowledge → Teaching Practice
relationships.summary: Direct estimate linking teacher knowledge to teaching practice.

relationships.label: Teaching Practice → Student Achievement
relationships.summary: Direct estimate linking teaching practice to student achievement.

relationships.label: Teacher Knowledge → Student Achievement
relationships.summary: Direct estimate linking teacher knowledge to student achievement.

relationships.label: Knowledge → Practice → Achievement
relationships.summary: Mediation or pathway analysis across knowledge, practice, and achievement.

relationships.label: PD design characteristic → Program impact
relationships.summary: Cross-study association between a PD program design characteristic and standardized program-level student achievement impacts across evaluated programs (not an ITT effect of receiving PD on student achievement).
